episodes.name: #1171 - Paycom Center in Oklahoma City, OK
episodes.summary: After winning the Royal Rumble Match, Ronda Rousey came to SmackDown for the first time and declared that she will challenge Charlotte Flair for the SmackDown Women's Title on The Grandest Stage of the Them All. Plus, Goldberg emerged to inform Universal Champion Roman Reigns that he's next at WWE Elimination Chamber.

episodes.name: #1172 - Smoothie King Center in New Orleans, LA
episodes.summary: Though WWE Official Sonya Deville was ordered to not lay a hand of Naomi, SmackDown Women's Champion Charlotte Flair emerged victorious over The Glow in a hard-fought title match. episodes.name: #1173 - Smoothie King Center in New Orleans, LA
episodes.summary: One night before WWE Elimination Chamber, The Master Strategist triumphed over Shinsuke Nakamura to recapture the Intercontinental Title, Goldberg came face-to-face with Universal Champion Roman Reigns and made a bold statement, and Ronda Rousey agreed to a stunning stipulation for her tag team match at Jeddah.

episodes.name: #1174 - Giant Center in Hershey, PA
episodes.summary: On a chaotic SmackDown, WWE Champion Brock Lesnar turned his contract signing with Universal Champion Roman Reigns for the Winner Take All Championship Unification Match completely upside down. Plus, Ronda Rousey repelled an attack by WWE Official Sonya Deville and SmackDown Women's Champion Charlotte Flair and so much more.

episodes.name: #1175 - FTX Arena in Miami, FL
episodes.summary: Ronda Rousey made Sonya Deville tap out in her SmackDown in-ring debut and introduced SmackDown Women's Champion Charlotte Flair to her excruciating ankle lock. Plus, Johnny Knoxville helped Ricochet capture the Intercontinental Title from Sami Zayn, The Usos conquered The Viking Raiders to retain the SmackDown Tag Team Titles and so much more.

episodes.name: #1176 - Legacy Arena in Birmingham, AL
episodes.summary: One week after Ronda Rousey surprised SmackDown Women's Champion Charlotte Flair with an ankle lock that made the titleholder tap out, The Opportunity roared back with brutal vengeance on The Baddest Woman on the Planet.

episodes.name: #1177 - Spectrum Center in Charlotte, NC
episodes.summary: Brock Lesnar smashed Roman Reigns' SUV with a forklift and tore the door off a nearby truck just to get his hands on The Head of the Table, who escaped The Beast's wrath. Plus, Charlotte Flair once again got the better of Ronda Rousey after goading her WrestleMania opponent into a fight and planting her through the announce table after Rousey refused to tap out.

episodes.name: #1178 - Barclays Center in Brooklyn, NY

episodes.name: #1243 - The O2 Arena in London, England
episodes.summary: On a frantic Friday Night SmackDown, The Bloodline Civil War began as The Usos and Roman Reigns & Solo Sikoa came to blows in the middle of the ring! Plus, Bianca Belair got involved in the WWE Women's Championship Match between Asuka and Charlotte Flair, Kevin Owens and Sami Zayn defeated Pretty Deadly to retain the Undisputed WWE Tag Team Championships, Shotzi had her hair cut off and so much more!

episodes.name: #1244 - Madison Square Garden in New York, NY
episodes.summary: On an incredible episode of SmackDown emanating from Madison Square Garden, Roman Reigns reaffirmed his place at the Head of the Table, AJ Styles defeated Karrion Kross, Edge battled and beat Grayson Waller, Sheamus unsuccessfully challenged Austin Theory for the United States Title, and more!

episodes.name: #1245 - PNC Arena in Raleigh, NC
episodes.summary: When Charlotte Flair attacked Bayley to prevent her and Ms. Money in the Bank IYO SKY from influencing the WWE Women's Title Match between Asuka and Bianca Belair, it ignited the fuse on a sequence of destruction that ended in a disqualification win for The EST of WWE. The Empress of Tomorrow then thwarted an attempted cash-in from SKY when she blasted The Role Model with the mist.

episodes.name: #1246 - Amway Center in Orlando, FL
episodes.summary: On a frenetic Friday Night SmackDown, the stakes between Undisputed WWE Universal Champion Roman Reigns and Jey Uso got magnified as Reigns agreed to put his Tribal Chiefdom on the line as well as his title against Jey at SummerSlam! Plus, "Dirty" Dominik Mysterio won his first NXT North American Title defense against Butch, Rey Mysterio advanced in the U.S. Title Invitational Tournament, Charlotte Flair overcame IYO SKY so much more!

episodes.name: #1247 - Smoothie King Center in New Orleans, LA
episodes.summary: Although Jey Uso stepped up his game en route to Tribal Combat against Undisputed WWE Universal Champion Roman Reigns at SummerSlam, The Head of the Table and Solo Sikoa absolutely dismantled him with a brutal beatdown just moments after his victory over Grayson Waller. Plus, Santos Escobar won the United States Invitational after the match was stopped due to a Rey Mysterio injury.

episodes.name: #1248 - Wright State University Nutter Center in Dayton, OH
episodes.summary: Jey Uso took on Solo Sikoa before Tribal Combat, LA Knight and Sheamus battled it out before the SummerSlam Battle Royal, we heard from WWE Women's Champion Asuka, Charlotte Flair, and Bianca Belair, and more!

episodes.name: #1249 - Scotiabank Saddledome in Calgary, AB
episodes.summary: On an amazing Friday Night SmackDown, Jey Uso exclaimed that he's out of WWE after Spearing Roman Reigns and superkicking his brother Jimmy! Plus, Rey Mysterio became the new United States Champion after defeating Austin Theory, Edge challenged Sheamus to a match at his 25th Anniversary Special and so much more!

episodes.name: #1250 - Scotiabank Arena in Toronto, ON
episodes.summary: Edge celebrates his 25th anniversary in WWE with a win over Sheamus.

episodes.name: #1251 - KFC Yum! Center in Louisville, KY
episodes.summary: WWE honored both Bray Wyatt and WWE Hall of Famer Terry Funk on an extremely emotional SmackDown. Plus, LA Knight overcame Finn Bálor, IYO SKY successfully defended her WWE Women's Title against The LWO's Zelina Vega, Bobby Lashley helped The Street Profits steal a win from The Brawling Brutes in a Terry Funk Hardcore Tag Team Match, Rey Mysterio defeated Grayson Waller and more.

episodes.name: #1252 - GIANT Center in Hershey, PA
episodes.summary: Payback looms as John Cena and Jimmy Uso return. Solo Sikoa vs AJ Styles. Santos Escobar, Rey Mysterio vs Austin Theory

episodes.name: #1253 - TD Garden in Boston, MA
episodes.summary: On a frantic Friday Night SmackDown, AJ Styles defeated Jimmy Uso before being ambushed by The Judgment Day as they fed him to be Samoan Spiked by Solo Sikoa. Plus, LA Knight defeated Austin Theory, Asuka reemerged to help Charlotte Flair and Shotzi beat Damage CTRL, and so much more!

episodes.name: #1255 - Desert Diamond Arena in Glendale, AZ
episodes.summary: John Cena and AJ Styles planned to face The Bloodline at WWE Fastlane, but Jimmy Uso and Solo Sikoa ruthlessly ambushed Styles backstage before dismantling Cena in the ring. Plus, IYO SKY retained her WWE Women's Title against Asuka, Bobby Lashley is seemingly at odds with The Street Profits and so much more!

episodes.name: #1256 - Golden 1 Center in Sacramento, CA
episodes.summary: In an explosive SmackDown, the electric LA Knight emerged to help John Cena repel Jimmy Uso and Solo Sikoa's chaotic assault before deciding to join forces with "The Greatest of All Time" against The Bloodline at WWE Fastlane.

episodes.name: #1257 - Enterprise Center in St. Louis, MO
episodes.summary: After Solo Sikoa caused LA Knight to defeat Jimmy Uso by disqualification, The Bloodline and The Judgment Day seemed to have the upper hand against LA Knight and John Cena. That was until Knight and Cena received a massive assist from Cody Rhodes and Jey Uso! Plus, Charlotte Flair and Asuka defeated IYO SKY and Bayley, Bobby Lashley took care of Rey Mysterio and so much more!

episodes.name: #1258 - BOK Center in Tulsa, OK
episodes.summary: Roman Reigns returns to SmackDown and sends a message to LA Knight

episodes.name: #1259 - AT&T Center in San Antonio, TX
episodes.summary: SPOILER ALERT!!!!!!   While IYO SKY retained her WWE Women's Title over Charlotte Flair, her night was far from over as she had to contend with the return of Bianca Belair! Plus, LA Knight vowed to defeat Roman Reigns, Logan Paul challenged U.S. Champion Rey Mysterio to a match at WWE Crown Jewel, Jey Uso led a surprise attack on Jimmy Uso after John Cena brawled with Solo Sikoa and so much more!

episodes.name: #1260 - Fiserv Forum in Milwaukee, WI
episodes.summary: Moments after LA Knight defeated Jimmy Uso, The Megastar blasted The Head of the Table with Blunt Force Trauma en route to the Undisputed WWE Universal Championship Match at WWE Crown Jewel. Plus, Solo Sikoa unleashed a brutal sneak attack on John Cena, and Bianca Belair returned focused on the gold.

episodes.name: #1261 - Fiserv Forum in Milwaukee, WI
episodes.summary: Bianca Belair made a statement in a win over Bayley, Roman Reigns and LA Knight came face-to-face one last time, and more as SmackDown set the stage for WWE Crown Jewel.

episodes.name: #1262 - Nationwide Arena in Columbus, OH
episodes.summary: The Empress of Tomorrow shocked the WWE Universe by turning on Bianca Belair and Charlotte Flair mid-match and aligning herself with Damage CTRL! Plus, Santos Escobar assaulted Rey Mysterio, LA Knight took out Grayson Waller and so much more!

episodes.name: #1263 - Ford Center in Evansville, IN
episodes.summary: Becky Lynch stuns Damage CTRL when she journeys to SmackDown to join forces with Charlotte Flair, Bianca Belair and Shotzi for a WarGames Match at Survivor Series.

episodes.name: #1353 - Bell Centre in Montreal, QC
episodes.summary:
John Cena is back on SmackDown after losing the Undisputed WWE Title to Cody Rhodes in a Street Fight at SummerSlam and following the stunning post-match beatdown he received at the hands of Brock Lesnar.

WWE Champion Cody Rhodes to address WWE Universe.

Alex Shelley and Chris Sabin are back in action after a grueling TLC Match at SummerSlam that saw them fail to capture the WWE Tag Team Title.

Their opponents will be Talla Tonga and JC Mateo of The MFTs, and United States Champion Solo Sikoa seems sure to be watching this match closely.

episodes.name: #1354 - TD Garden in Boston, MA
episodes.summary:
Last week, Drew McIntyre Claymore'd Undisputed WWE Champion Cody Rhodes right into the announce table, exploding the side of the table into splinters. This week, The Scottish Warrior will address his heinous actions.

Last week, Gargano, Tommaso Ciampa and LeRae confronted The Street Profits, accusing them of hurting LeRae. This week, these two teams will tangle in a grudge match.

Now, it's Bliss' turn. Five Feet of Fury is set to step in the ring with the dangerous Piper Niven. 

The 2025 Andre The Giant Battle Royal Memorial winner is determined to vault himself into the title scene, and The Miz has promised to lead him to those new heights. Fraxiom, meanwhile, are fighting to get back into the WWE Tag Team Title picture as The Wyatt Sicks currently dominate the landscape. Can Melo Don't Miz score a major tag team victory or will Fraxiom be on their way to another championship opportunity?

episodes.name: #1355 - 3Arena in Dublin, Ireland
episodes.summary:
John Cena returns to SmackDown en route to battling Logan Paul at WWE Clash in Paris. 

Now The Queen is looking for payback when she goes one-on-one with Niven. 

As a result of a backstage altercation last week, Motor City Machine Guns will take on Melo Don't Miz. After some rough waters in recent weeks, will The Miz and Carmelo Hayes be on the same page against their veteran tandem adversaries?

SmackDown's red-hot tag team division continues to set Friday night ablaze as The Street Profits step in the ring with two members of the dangerous MFTs. 

R-Truth must channel every bit of his inner Ron Killings when he faces the ominous Aleister Black.

episodes.name: #1356 - LDLC Arena in Lyon-Décines, France
episodes.summary:
Sami Zayn has pinned United States Champion Solo Sikoa and continues to be a huge thorn in the side of The MFTs.

How will John Cena respond to Logan Paul's blindside attack when he returns to SmackDown just one night before their blockbuster match at WWE Clash in Paris?

After fighting through the SmackDown tag teams in recent weeks, The Street Profits and Melo Don't Miz will battle each other for the right to challenge WWE Tag Team Champions Joe Gacy and Dexter Lumis of The Wyatt Sicks. 

Charlotte Flair and Alexa Bliss are set to defend the WWE Women's Tag Team Championship against Piper Niven and Alba Fyre.  

Michin wants a WWE Women's United States Championship Match against Giulia.

episodes.name: #1357 - Allstate Arena in Chicago, IL
episodes.summary:
John Cena is rolling into The Windy City one last time. 
 

After conquering Solo Sikoa last week to finally claim the United States Championship, Sami Zayn returns to SmackDown with the star-spangled title.

episodes.name: #1358 - Scope Arena in Norfolk, VA
episodes.summary:
Brock Lesnar made an epic return last week on SmackDown, taking out John Cena once again. With their match set for Wrestlepalooza, what will The Beast have to say live on SmackDown?

WWE Women's Champion Tiffany Stratton and Jade Cargill will engage in an epic SummerSlam rematch for the ages.

In an epic grudge match, Randy Orton will take on Drew McIntyre.

episodes.name: #1359 - Huntington Center in Toledo, OH
episodes.summary:
The American Nightmare and The Scottish Psychopath will sign the contract for Wrestlepalooza. 

Brock Lesnar returns to SmackDown and gives an exclusive interview ahead of his blockbuster match with John Cena at Wrestlepalooza.

Charlotte Flair and Alexa Bliss will put their title on the line against Chelsea Green and Alba Fyre.

For the third week in a row, Sami Zayn will hold a United States Championship Open Challenge on SmackDown. Not one to wait, Carmelo Hayes has already declared that he will be accepting the title opportunity.

episodes.name: #1360 - Kia Center in Orlando, FL
episodes.summary:
WWE Women's Champion Tiffany Stratton is undefeated in 2025. Following a chaotic few weeks, however, the titleholder must now defend the championship against Jade Cargill and Nia Jax in a Triple Threat Match.

Cody Rhodes returns to SmackDown with his sights set on World Heavyweight Champion Seth Rollins and the Crown Jewel Title.

Sami Zayn will issue his fourth United States Championship Open Challenge in as many weeks. 

Following recent turmoil, Michin and B-Fab are set to join forces against Women's United States Champion Giulia and Kiana James.

episodes.name: #1361 - Heritage Bank Center in Cincinnati, OH
episodes.summary:
American Nightmare will join forces with The Viper against The Vision.

Sami Zayn will issue his fifth United States Championship Open Challenge in as many weeks. 

WWE Women's Champion Tiffany Stratton sets her sights on Women's World Champion Stephanie Vaquer and the Crown Jewel Championship.

episodes.name: #1362 - RAC Arena in Perth, Australia
episodes.summary:
Undisputed WWE Champion Cody Rhodes takes to the mic just one night before facing World Heavyweight Champion Seth Rollins at WWE Crown Jewel.

Former titleholders The Street Profits are set to challenge The Wyatt Sicks. 
Can Montez Ford and Angelo Dawkins overcome the darkness to once again claim the gold? 

Sami Zayn is set to issue his sixth United States Title Open Challenge in as many weeks. Find out who will step into the spotlight to challenge the hardest-working titleholder in the business.

episodes.name: #1363 - SAP Center in San Jose, CA
episodes.summary:
After World Heavyweight Champion Seth Rollins defeated Undisputed WWE Champion Cody Rhodes and won the WWE Crown Jewel Title in controversial fashion, Rhodes returns to SmackDown to kick off the show.

Jacob Fatu and Drew McIntyre have been engaged in a volatile rivalry, and the aggressive Superstars will finally collide one-on-one. 

WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Charlotte Flair and Alexa Bliss may not be best friends, but the titleholders have been effective together in the ring.  After stepping up to The Queen and Five Feet of Fury backstage, NXT's Sol Ruca and Zaria are now looking to prove themselves by becoming champions.

episodes.name: #1364 - Mullet Arena in Tempe, AZ
episodes.summary:
Rhodes and McIntyre prepare for a title clash at Saturday Night's Main Event on Nov. 1.

The triumphant Dragunov will celebrate his success by issuing another Open Challenge for the championship tonight.

WWE Women's Champion Tiffany Stratton is out to show Kiana James why SmackDown runs on Tiffy Time.

Shinsuke Nakamura & Rey Fenix join forces against the MFTs in tag team action, tonight on SmackDown.

episodes.name: #1365 - Delta Center in Salt Lake City, UT
episodes.summary:
What is in store for Undisputed WWE Champion Cody Rhodes and Drew McIntyre when they take part in a Contract Signing just one night before their title rematch at Saturday Night's Main Event?

Jade Cargill will address the WWE Universe before battling the titleholder at Saturday Night's Main Event. 

WWE Women's Tag Team Champion Alexa Bliss is set to clash with her one-time friend Nia Jax. 

Hayes' new focus did not prevent him from taking exception when Kit Wilson accused him of giving off "toxic masculinity" backstage. Wilson's words may prove Pretty Deadly when he squares off against Hayes.

episodes.name: #1366 - Bon Secours Wellness Arena in Greenville, SC
episodes.summary:
With Rhodes still on top, what's next for The American Nightmare?

After dethroning Tiffany Stratton at Saturday Night's Main Event, Jade Cargill is the new WWE Women's Champion, and SmackDown has never been stormier. How will Cargill mark her return?

After a backstage confrontation last week, Giulia will defend her Women's United States Title against former champion Chelsea Green.

United States Champion Ilja Dragunov has continued the tradition of the United States Title Open Challenge. Who will be the next Superstar to answer the call?

Nia Jax will face WWE Women's Tag Team Champion Charlotte Flair after losing to Alexa Bliss last week. Can Jax fare better against Flair? 

Can Fenix fell the tree-like Tonga?

episodes.name: #1367 - MVP Arena in Albany, NY
episodes.summary:
The Last Time is Now Tournament continues on SmackDown with Jey Uso from Raw taking on The Miz from SmackDown.

Who will be the mystery opponent to face Knight?

After a backstage confrontation, B-Fab will clash with WWE Women's Champion Jade Cargill in a non-title match.

episodes.summary:
LA Knight squares off against Gunther to determine John Cena's final opponent at Saturday Night's Main Event.

After falling short of a team victory at Survivor Series: WarGames, find out what's in store for Undisputed WWE Champion Cody Rhodes.

Who will step into the spotlight and attempt to dethrone Ilja Dragunov?

WWE Women's Champion Jade Cargill will face off with Alba Fyre of Women's United States Champion Chelsea Green's Secret Hervice. 

After being part of a chaotic WarGames Match at Survivor Series, Alexa Bliss will look to get herself and Charlotte Flair back in the title picture when she battles WWE Women's Tag Team Champion Kairi Sane one-on-one. 

Solo Sikoa is set to respond to the shocking ending of last week's SmackDown.

SNME go-home show.

episodes.summary:
What will the Undisputed WWE Champion say?

Joe Gacy and Dexter Lumis of The Wyatt Sicks will defend the WWE Tag Team Championship against two members of The MFTs. 

United States Champion Ilja Dragunov and Carmelo Hayes join forces to take on Johnny Gargano and Tommaso Ciampa.

Tonight, WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Asuka and Kairi Sane take on Nia Jax and Lash Legend in a non-title match. 

Giulia is set to battle against Alba Fyre of The Secret Hervice in her quest to reclaim the Women's United States Championship from Chelsea Green.

episodes.name: #1373 - Van Andel Arena in Grand Rapids, MI
episodes.summary:
On Friday, Drew McIntyre will make his return one week after Undisputed WWE Champion Cody Rhodes invaded his home and brawled with The Scottish Psychopath.

Tonight, Ilja Dragunov will host another United States Title Open Challenge. Who will answer the challenge this week? 

After their encounter at Saturday Night's Main Event, Joe Hendry and The Miz will go one-on-one in what should be a closely contested matchup.

episodes.summary:
Cody Rhodes to appear.

Alexa Bliss, Charlotte Flair, Rhea Ripley & Iyo Sky vs The Kabuki Warriors, Nia Jax & Lash Legend – Eight-Woman Tag Team match.

Jade Cargill vs Michin.

Damian Priest vs Aleister Black: Ambulance match.

episodes.name: #1375 - Uber Arena in Berlin, Germany
episodes.summary:
After returning to hit The Miz with two RKOs last week, Randy Orton is set to take to the mic on SmackDown.

Cody Rhodes is going to war against Drew McIntyre in a Three Stages of Hell Match for the Undisputed WWE Championship, a showdown that will include three parts: a traditional singles match, a Falls Count Anywhere Match and a Steel Cage Match. 

In a battle of family vs. family, The Wyatt Sicks will take on The MFTs in an Eight-Man Tag Team Match.

Following a confrontation last week, Trick Williams will compete in his first SmackDown match when he battles Rey Fenix. 

After reclaiming the Women's United States Championship from Chelsea Green, Giulia will engage in her first title defense when she battles five-time Women's Champion Alexa Bliss.

Tonight, newly-crowned titleholder Carmelo Hayes will carry on the traditional that was reignited by both Sami Zayn and Ilja Dragunov when he hosts a United States Title Open Challenge.

episodes.name: #1376 - OVA Arena Wembley in London, England
episodes.summary:
After his controversial win against Cody Rhodes in the Three Stages of Hell Match, Drew McIntyre returns to SmackDown as the new Undisputed WWE Champion.

After treating The Miz to two weeks of RKOs, Randy Orton will go head-to-head with The A-Lister in an Undisputed WWE Championship No. 1 Contender's Qualifying Match. 

Damian Priest will battle Solo Sikoa in an Undisputed WWE Championship No. 1 Contender's Qualifying Match. 

Sami Zayn takes on Ilja Dragunov in an Undisputed WWE Championship No. 1 Contender's Qualifying Match. 

In an intriguing matchup, Matt Cardona will step in the ring against Trick Williams in an Undisputed WWE Championship No. 1 Contender's Qualifying Match. 

Tonight, Carmelo Hayes will continue the tradition that was reignited by Sami Zayn and Ilja Dragunov when he once again hosts a United States Title Open Challenge. Who will answer the challenge this week?

episodes.name: #1377 - Bell Centre in Montreal, QC
episodes.summary:
Giulia & Kiana James vs Charlotte Flair & Alexa Bliss vs Nia Jax & Lash Legend – #1 Contenders triple threat match for the Women's Tag Team titles.

The Wyatt Sicks (Joe Gacy & Dexter Lumis) (c) vs The MFTs – WWE Tag Team titles.

Tonight, Carmelo Hayes will continue the tradition that was reignited by Sami Zayn and Ilja Dragunov when he once again hosts a United States Title Open Challenge. Who will answer the challenge this week? 

After finding herself in the middle of the confrontation between WWE Women's Champion Jade Cargill and Jordynne Grace, Chelsea Green must now face the wrathful Storm.

Cody Rhodes will sit down for an exclusive interview one night before his match against The Samoan Werewolf at Saturday Night's Main Event.

Trick Williams vs Damian Priest.

Nathan Frazer vs Johnny Gargano.

episodes.name: #1378 - Riyadh Season Stadium at KAFD in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
episodes.summary:
After defeating Randy Orton, Damian Priest and Trick Williams in a Fatal 4-Way Match at Saturday Night's Main Event to become the No. 1 Contender to Undisputed WWE Champion Drew McIntyre, Sami Zayn will come face-to-face with the titleholder one night before their clash at Royal Rumble. 

After engaging in a chaotic brawl with Jacob Fatu at Saturday Night's Main Event, Cody Rhodes returns to SmackDown en route to the Royal Rumble Match.

After The Miz cost him his United States Title Match against Carmelo Hayes last week, Ilja Dragunov is out for retribution when he takes on The A-Lister.

After helping his tag team partner Nathan Frazer defeat Johnny Gargano by thwarting the disruptive Candice LeRae, Axiom will get an opportunity to combat Johnny Wrestling. 

Fighting champion Carmelo Hayes has issued another United States Title Open Challenge. Who will step into the spotlight to attempt to dethrone Him?

episodes.name: #1379 - Spectrum Center in Charlotte, NC
episodes.summary:
Shinsuke Nakamura is set to step into the ring against Tama Tonga. 

Now, Morgan journeys to SmackDown to weigh her options on The Road to WrestleMania. 

United States Champion Giulia and Kiana James challenge RHIYO for the WWE Women's Tag Team Title, tonight.

Randy Orton, Solo Sikoa and Aleister Black will collide in an Elimination Chamber Triple Threat Qualifying Match.

Tiffany Stratton, Lash Legend and Chelsea Green will battle in an Elimination Chamber Triple Threat Qualifying Match.

Carmelo Hayes once again will issue an United States Title Open Challenge. Who will answer the challenge this week?

episodes.name: #1380 - American Airlines Center in Dallas, TX
episodes.summary:
Cody Rhodes, Jacob Fatu and Sami Zayn will battle for the right to enter the deadly Elimination Chamber.

Women's United States Champion Giulia, Alexa Bliss and Zelina will collide in an Elimination Chamber Triple Threat Qualifying Match. 

Jordynne Grace has been gunning for a WWE Women's Championship Match against Jade Cargill. 

Rhea Ripley and IYO SKY battle Nia Jax and Lash Legend in a WWE Women's Tag Team Championship Match.

Rey Fenix goes head-to-head with Trick Williams.

episodes.name: #1381 - Amerant Bank Arena in Fort Lauderdale, FL
episodes.summary:
Nia Jax vs Charlotte Flair vs Kiana James – Women's Elimination Chamber Qualifying match.

Trick Williams vs Carmelo Hayes vs Damian Priest – Men's Elimination Chamber Qualifying match.

Former United States Champion Ilja Dragunov is set to go one-on-one with Tama Tonga of The MFTs.

Women's United States Champion Giulia takes on WWE Women's Tag Team Champion Rhea Ripley. 

Oba Femi vs Kit Wilson.

Cody Rhodes, Tiffany Stratton, Randy Orton, Jade Cargill & LA Knight are listed as featured superstars.

episodes.name: #1382 - KFC Yum! Center in Louisville, KY
episodes.summary:
One night before battling inside the Elimination Chamber for the opportunity to challenge Drew McIntyre for the Undisputed WWE Championship at WrestleMania, Randy Orton, Cody Rhodes, Je'Von Evans, Jey Uso, LA Knight and Trick Williams will stand in the ring together on SmackDown. 

Two weeks a chaotic conclusion to the WWE Women's Tag Team Title bout that pitted Rhea Ripley and IYO SKY against Nia Jax and Lash Legend, RHIYO will once again put their title on the line against The Irresistible Forces.

Uncle Howdy will finally go one-on-one with Solo Sikoa. 

Last week, The Miz offered to help Oba Femi reach his full potential. 

After a backstage altercation last week, up-and-comer Jordynne Grace will step into the squared circle with Candice LeRae.

episodes.name: #1383 - Moda Center in Portland, OR
episodes.summary:
Will McIntyre or Rhodes secure the gold? Who will go on to battle Elimination Chamber winner Randy Orton on The Grandest Stage of Them All?

Rhea Ripley journeys to SmackDown to address her WWE Women's Championship opportunity against Jade Cargill at WrestleMania.

Six elite SmackDown tandems will battle it out in a No. 1 Contenders' Tag Team Turmoil Match to decide who will be The MFTs' next opponents.

Tonight, Carmelo Hayes will once again host a United States Title Open Challenge. Who will answer the challenge this week?

Nia Jax and Lash Legend will mark their huge title victory with a special Irresistible Forces' Celebration.

episodes.name: #1384 - Mortgage Matchup Center in Phoenix, AZ
episodes.summary:
After Cody Rhodes defeated Drew McIntyre to reclaim the Undisputed WWE Championship last week on SmackDown, The American Nightmare and Elimination Chamber winner Randy Orton will sign the contract for their match at The Showcase of the Immortals. 

WWE Women's Tag Team Champions The Irresistible Forces will defend against former titleholders Alexa Bliss and Charlotte Flair in a highly-anticipated showdown. 

"Miz TV" returns as The A-Lister welcomes special guest and three-time Grammy Award winner Jelly Roll back to SmackDown.

With a title match against Rhea Ripley on the horizon at WrestleMania, WWE Women's Champion Jade Cargill is set to tangle with her Kendo stick-wielding adversary Michin on SmackDown. 

A new chapter in the intense rivalry between The MFTs and The Wyatt Sicks is about to be written, as WWE Tag Team Champions Solo Sikoa and Tama Tonga lock horns with Uncle Howdy and Erick Rowan in a non-title match.

episodes.name: #1385 - Lenovo Center in Raleigh, NC
episodes.summary:
After a shocking attack on Cody Rhodes during last week's WrestleMania Contract Signing, Randy Orton will explain the vicious ambush of a man he considered his brother.

After becoming the No. 1 Contenders in a Tag Team Turmoil Match, Damian Priest and R-Truth are set to challenge WWE Tag Team Champions The MFTs. 

WWE Hall of Famers The Bella Twins have returned to WWE in search of the WWE Women's Tag Team Championship. This Friday, Nikki and Brie will look to realize that goal when they challenge Nia Jax and Lash Legend.

Jacob Fatu played a vital role in Drew McIntyre losing the Undisputed WWE Title back to Cody Rhodes, and The Scottish Psychopath is out for retribution against The Samoan Werewolf.

"Miz TV" turned chaotic last week when Kit Wilson accused Grammy Award-winning artist Jelly Roll of being "fat-phobic" and toxic. Now Wilson is calling out Jelly Roll.  

With friction apparent between them over whether or not to help Johnny Gargano, Alex Shelley and Chris Sabin look to get back on track in a high speed tag team matchup against Fraxiom.

episodes.name: #1386 - PPG Paints Arena in Pittsburgh, PA
episodes.summary:
Just one week after savagely attacking his former friend and brother, Undisputed WWE Champion Cody Rhodes, Randy Orton unleashed another vicious assault on Matt Cardona. Which Superstar will The Legend Killer ambush next? 

After Alexa Bliss and Charlotte Flair inadvertently cost The Bella Twins a chance to win the WWE Women's Tag Team Title against The Irresistible Forces, the two teams got into a tense argument backstage. On Friday, the two teams will collide in the ring.

General Manager Nick Aldis will provide an update on the condition of The Scottish Psychopath and The Samoan Werewolf. 

Jelly Roll will step back into the squared circle for the first time since SummerSlam to take on Kit Wilson.

Women's United States Champion Giulia is set to clash with former WWE Women's Champion Tiffany Stratton in an explosive non-title showdown on The Road to WrestleMania.

episodes.name: #1387 - Enterprise Center in St. Louis, MO
episodes.summary:
How will the Undisputed WWE Champion respond to Orton's attack on Jelly Roll last week? How will he take the fight to Orton in The Viper's hometown?

For the second week in a row, WWE Women's Champion Jade Cargill, B-Fab and Michin took out Rhea Ripley.  How will The Eradicator respond to the WWE Women's Champion and her new allies on The Road to WrestleMania? 

Brace yourself for the fallout after General Manager Nick Aldis put Jacob Fatu into an Unsanctioned Match against Drew McIntyre at WrestleMania.

episodes.name: #1388 - SAP Center in San Jose, CA
episodes.summary:
What will Rhodes do to strike back against Orton and McAfee? 

Drew McIntyre believes that his WrestleMania opponent Jacob Fatu is nothing more than a criminal, and he has vowed to expose the "real" Samoan Werewolf on SmackDown.

What will Sami have in store for Trick as they prepare to clash for the championship at WrestleMania? 

The Eradicator will address the WWE Women's Champion as she readies herself to challenge The Storm at WrestleMania,

The highly-anticipated SmackDown debut of Royce Keys is set to take place this Friday.

episodes.name: #1389 - T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, NV
episodes.summary:
Undisputed WWE Champion Cody Rhodes is primed to deliver a message to Randy Orton just one night before their title showdown on The Grandest Stage of Them All. 

How will Jacob Fatu respond to Drew McIntyre's brutal attack last week on SmackDown as The Samoan Werewolf prepares to battle The Scottish Psychopath in an Unsanctioned Match at WrestleMania? 

A WrestleMania-sized edition of SmackDown will feature the 12th Andre the Giant Memorial Battle Royal. With Superstars from Raw and SmackDown appearing to kick off WrestleMania weekend, who will hoist the trophy? 

On the eve of WrestleMania 42, The Wyatt Sicks will battle longtime adversaries The MFTs in an Eight-Man Tag Team Street Fight.

episodes.name: #1390 - Dickies Arena in Fort Worth, TX
episodes.summary:
After defeating Jade Cargill on The Grandest Stage of Them All, Rhea Ripley journeys to SmackDown as the new WWE Women's Champion. 

Trick Williams will celebrate his title victory with Lil Yachty on the SmackDown after WrestleMania.

After overcoming Jordynne Grace last week, new No. 1 Contender Tiffany Stratton is set to challenge Giulia for the Women's United States Championship.

After returning to WWE to help Brie Bella capture the WWE Women's Tag Team Championship at The Show of Shows, Paige returns to SmackDown for the first time in nearly a decade. 

Jacob Fatu the Samoan Werewolf will be LIVE on SmackDown.

episodes.name: #1391 - BOK Center in Tulsa, OK
episodes.summary:
The American Nightmare Cody Rhodes kicks off SmackDown tonight.

After an explosive confrontation with World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns on Raw, what will be the fallout for Jacob Fatu heading into his title match against The OTC at WWE Backlash?

Tonight, The Queen is taking it upon herself to teach a valuable lesson to The Rockstar when they square off one-on-one.

Dynamic NXT Superstar Ricky Saints is set to make his SmackDown debut tonight.

episodes.name: #1392 - VyStar Veterans Memorial Arena in Jacksonville, FL
episodes.summary:
Fatu is set to kick off SmackDown on Friday, one night before he challenges Reigns for the World Heavyweight Championship at WWE Backlash. Find out what bedlam will be unleashed.

After a unleashing a surprise attack on Undisputed WWE Champion Cody Rhodes last week, Gunther will address the WWE Universe. 

Trick Williams will host a funeral for the Gingerbread Man one night before defending the United States Championship against Sami Zayn at WWE Backlash.

WWE Women's Champion Rhea Ripley will stand united with Charlotte Flair and Alexa Bliss to attempt to quell the rising threat of Fatal Influence in a Six-Woman Tag Team Match.

Stratton goes one-on-one against Kiana James in a showdown for the gold.

Priest will be out for payback when he undertakes the monstrous task of battling Tonga one-on-one.

episodes.name: #1393 - Colonial Life Arena in Columbia, SC
episodes.summary:
Will Gunther, however, officially move to SmackDown in order to challenge The American Nightmare.

After successfully defending the United States Championship against Sami Zayn at WWE Backlash, Trick Williams will walk back into the University of South Carolina in his lemon pepper steppers for a special homecoming celebration.

episodes.name: #1394 - Rupp Arena in Lexington, KY
episodes.summary:
How will Gunther respond one week before challenging The American Nightmare for the title at WWE Clash in Italy?

WWE Women's Champion Rhea Ripley is set to kick off SmackDown tonight to answer Jade Cargill's challenge for a rematch for the title at WWE Clash in Italy. Brace yourself for The Eradicator, tonight.

Tiffany Stratton will issue a Women's United States Championship Open Challenge. Who will step into the spotlight to attempt to stop Tiffy Time?

After returning to SmackDown to defeat Ricky Saints last week, Carmelo Hayes has a message for United States Champion Trick Williams and Lil Yachty.

Shinsuke Nakamura has been planting dissent in the mind of Tama Tonga for some time. Tonight, The Artist will go one-on-one with the dangerous Tonga.

episodes.name: #1395 - Olimpic Arena in Barcelona, Spain
episodes.summary:
Cody Rhodes will address Gunther's attack last week on SmackDown, as The American Nightmare prepares to defend the Undisputed WWE Championship against The Ring General in a highly-anticipated showdown at WWE Clash in Italy this Sunday.

After pinning Rhea Ripley at Saturday Night's Main Event, Jade Cargill has a final message for The Eradicator just two days before they collide for the WWE Women's Championship at WWE Clash in Italy! Brace yourself for The Storm.

Axiom is set to go one-on-one with The Miz after The A-Lister and Kit Wilson got into a backstage altercation with Fraxiom last week on SmackDown. Will Danhausen's "curse" continue to plague The A-Lister when he looks to defeat Axiom in his home country of Spain? 

After Rickey Saints cost Carmelo Hayes his match against United States Champion Trick Williams last week, the two Superstars will once again go one-on-one.

episodes.name: #1396 - Unipol Arena in Bologna, Italy
episodes.summary:
After a successful but controversial title defense against Gunther at WWE Clash in Italy, Undisputed WWE Champion Cody Rhodes will find out what Bologna, Italy wants to talk about.

After Rhea Ripley successfully defended the WWE Women's Championship against former titleholder Jade Cargill at WWE Clash in Italy, find out what's next for the champion.

Bayley, Raquel Rodriguez, Jacy Jayne and Kiana James will mix it up in a Fatal 4-Way Queen of the Ring First-Round Match. Who will earn a crucial victory in the high-stakes tournament?

WWE Tag Team Champion Damian Priest, United States Champion Trick Williams, World Tag Team Champion Bron Breakker and AAA Mega Champion Dominik Mysterio are set to battle in a Fatal 4-Way King of the Ring First-Round Match. Who will advance in the high-stakes tournament?

After battling to a double count-out and brawling after the bell last week, Carmelo Hayes and Ricky Saints will once again collide when SmackDown comes to in Bologna, Italy.

episodes.name: #1397 - Amica Mutual Pavilion in Providence, RI
episodes.summary:
Gunther is once again coming for Undisputed WWE Champion Cody Rhodes. What stipulation will The Ring General choose for his title showdown against The American Nightmare? How will Rhodes respond?

Women's Intercontinental Champion Sol Ruca, Charlotte Flair, Lyra Valkyria and Jade Cargill are set to battle in a Fatal 4-Way Queen of the Ring Tournament Match. 

Women's Intercontinental Champion Sol Ruca, Charlotte Flair, Lyra Valkyria and Jade Cargill are set to battle in a Fatal 4-Way Queen of the Ring Tournament Match. Who will seize the final first-round victory to advance to the Queen of the Ring Semifinals?

"Main Event" Jey Uso, LA Knight, Finn Bálor and Royce Keys are set to go to war in a Fatal 4-Way King of the Ring Tournament Match. Who will seize the final first-round victory and advance to the King of the Ring Semifinals? 

WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Paige and Brie Bella step into the ring with the dangerous Fallon Henley and Lainey Reid of Fatal Influence in an exciting non-title match.

episodes.name: #1398 - T-Mobile Arena in Kansas City, MO
episodes.summary:
Cody Rhodes is set to battle Gunther in a commercial-free Undisputed WWE Championship rematch. What will happen in the turbulent title matchup? 

Charlotte Flair is set to take on Women's World Champion Liv Morgan in the Queen of the Ring Tournament Semifinals. The winner will clash with IYO SKY in the final at WWE Night of Champions for the crown and the opportunity to challenge a World Champion at SummerSlam. 

"Main Event" Jey Uso is set to battle Je'Von Evans in the King of the Ring Tournament Semifinals. The winner of the explosive showdown will take on Oba Femi in the final at WWE Night of Champions to earn the right to challenge a World Champion at SummerSlam. Will Jey earn the right to compete in the King of the Ring Final on his own? Or is Night of Champions about to get bouncy? 

WWE Tag Team Champions Damian Priest and R-Truth are set to defend the title against Talla Tonga and Tama Tonga. 

Carmelo Hayes and Ricky Saints are about to write the next chapter in their heated rivalry when they battle to earn the right to challenge United States Champion Trick Williams at WWE Night of Champions.

episodes.name: #1399 - The O2 in London, England
episodes.summary:
On the eve of their Triple Threat Match at WWE Night of Champions, Undisputed WWE Champion Cody Rhodes will address Gunther and Sami Zayn. What will The American Nightmare want to talk about on the night before the epic free-for-all? 

After defeating Axiom a few weeks ago in his first title defense, Rey Fenix will bring the AAA Cruiserweight Championship back to SmackDown to battle Axiom's tag team partner Nathan Frazer.

Trick Williams must now put his title on the line against Ricky Saints at WWE Night of Champions. How will Trick prepare for his dangerous opponent? Find out tonight.

England's own Paige will go one-on-one with Fatal Influence's Jacy Jayne in Paige's first singles match since her return to action. Can one-half of the WWE Women's Tag Team Champions earn a home country win in England? 

Former business associates Giulia and Kiana James will battle it out for the first time since their falling out.

episodes.name: #1400 - Jim Whelan Boardwalk Hall in Atlantic City, NJ
episodes.summary:
New Undisputed WWE Champion Sami Zayn returns to SmackDown after miraculously winning the title in a Triple Threat Match against Cody Rhodes and Gunther at Night of Champions. How will the new champ celebrate his victory?

Women's United States Champion Tiffany Stratton, Charlotte Flair and Chelsea Green will team together when they take on Jade Cargill, Michin and B-Fab in a Six-Woman Tag Team Match.

Entering SmackDown on an impressive winning streak, AAA Cruiserweight Champion Rey Fenix will once again defend his title, this time against El Hijo del Vikingo. 

WWE Women's Tag Team Champion Brie Bella will take on Fatal Influence's Lainey Reid in a high-stakes match.

episodes.name: #1401 - Paycom Center in Oklahoma City, OK
episodes.summary:
Chicago's own CM Punk stepped in to replace The American Nightmare in a title match against Sami Zayn, ultimately capturing the Undisputed WWE Championship.

Don't miss when Trick Williams and Carmelo Hayes look to settle things this Friday night.

No longer a member of The MFTs, Tama Tonga will go head-to-head with Finn Bálor.

episodes.name: #1402 - MVP Arena in Albany, NY
episodes.summary:
What will happen after Gunther attacked SmackDown General Manager Nick Aldis last week?  Will it affect Saturday Night's Main Event where The Ring General is scheduled to team with Sami Zayn against Undisputed WWE Champion CM Punk and Cody Rhodes? 

How will Cody Rhodes react to teaming with Undisputed WWE Champion CM Punk against Gunther and Sami Zayn at Saturday Night's Main Event en route to their title match at SummerSlam?

After suffering a backstage attack by Tama Tonga and Talla Tonga two weeks ago, Finn Bálor got payback when he took them out with a Senton before finishing Tama with the Coup de Grace. What will happen when The Prince battles Talla Tonga?

episodes.name: #1403 - Oakland Arena in Oakland, CA
episodes.summary:
How will The Best in the World CM Punk and The American Nightmare Cody Rhodes react en route to their highly-anticipated title showdown at The Biggest Event of the Summer?

After being blindsided by Nick Aldis on Saturday Night's Main Event last weekend, Gunther is set to discuss his match against the SmackDown General Manager on SmackDown.

The Queen Charlotte Flair will go one-on-one against Nia Jax in another Qualifying Match. 

Chelsea Green is set to clash with Kiana James to see who will qualify for the Ladder Match to determine the Interim WWE Women's Champion at SummerSlam.
